授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.授業科目の目的（日本語）:
高電圧工学は電気機器・電子デバイス等の絶縁設計の基礎となる学問である。一方,パルスパワー工学は，電磁エネルギーを時空間的に圧縮して得られる電力（パルスパワー）の発生，伝送，計測，応用を取り扱う。本講義では,高電圧工学とパルスパワー工学の基礎を中心として学ぶ。
以下に主な講義内容を記す。
1 高電圧パルスパワー工学の基礎
2 高電圧現象と絶縁破壊
3 高電圧パルスパワー発生
4 高電圧パルスパワー伝送，制御
5 高電圧パルスパワー計測
6 パルスパワー応用
授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.授業科目の目的（英語）:
High voltage engineering is one of most important study of electrical engineering especially for the insulation designs for an electric apparatus, the electronic device, and so on. On the other hand, pulse power is provided to be compressed electromagnetic energy in a small space and a short time. The application is spreading into many fields, and the pulse power engineering continues developing now. Through this lecture, students learn mainly on the basics and applications of high voltage engineering and pulse power engineering.
Main contents:
1. The basics of high voltage and pulse power engineering
2. High voltage phenomena and breakdown of materials
3. Generation of pulse power using high voltage
4. Transmission of pulse power
5. Measurements of high voltage and pulse power
6. Applications of pulse power
